name: fsd.data.frame
title: Fast sample standard deviation, divided by n - 1.

origin.description: Fast sample standard deviation, divided by n - 1.

arguments.name: x
arguments.text: A numeric vector, a matrix, or a data frame given as a dict of columns.

arguments.name: g
arguments.text: A grouping vector. Levels are sorted, and a missing group is its own level.

arguments.name: w
arguments.text: Numeric weights of the same length as the data.

arguments.name: TRA
arguments.text: A transformation applied to the statistic: replace, fill, or an arithmetic operator. It is checked through TRA.

arguments.name: na.rm
arguments.text: When true, missing values are skipped. The default is true.

arguments.name: use.g.names
arguments.text: Name the result with the group levels.

arguments.name: drop
arguments.text: When true and there is no grouping, return a vector rather than a one-row table.

arguments.name: stable.algo
arguments.text: When true, use Welford's method. When false, use the sum of squares.

origin.details: Fast sample standard deviation, divided by n - 1. grouping by several columns, grouped data frames, and zoo are not included. nthreads is accepted and the single-thread result is returned.
origin.value: A numeric vector, matrix, or data frame.
origin.example:
.libPaths(c(path.expand("~/R/library"), .libPaths()))
suppressPackageStartupMessages(library(collapse))
fNobs <- function(x, ...) fnobs(x, ...)
x <- c(1, NA, 3, 4, 5, NA)
g <- c("b", "a", "b", "a", "b", "a")
w <- c(1, 2, 1, 1, 2, 1)
m <- matrix(c(1, NA, 3, 4, 5, 6), nrow = 3)
d <- data.frame(y = c(1, NA, 3), x = c(4, 5, 6))
gm <- c("b", "a", "b")
grab <- function(obj) {
  vals <- if (is.data.frame(obj)) as.numeric(unlist(obj, use.names = FALSE)) else as.numeric(obj)
  ifelse(is.na(vals), "NA", sprintf("%.17g", vals))
}

print(fsd.data.frame(d))
